record_contract.forms: Representative words, case markers, particles, affixes, or constructions used in this lesson's semantic territory. This is not a promise of exhaustive grammar coverage.
record_contract.own_grammar_blurb: Optional learner-facing explanation written in the language itself, describing how that language handles this semantic territory. The lesson may show this only when the language belongs to the learner's own profile; an injected reference anchor can show forms without this paragraph.
record_contract.comparison_blurb: Legacy machine-draft native explanation retained for research and backfill compatibility. New learner-facing teaching copy should use own_grammar_blurb.
record_contract.review_state: Generated/research-required records are candidates. Promotion to reviewed/verified follows the normal Gef trust ladder.
